name: Cross-account KMS delegation to an external root
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 113. An account-root principal for an account that DIFFERS from the key's owning account is a CROSS-ACCOUNT KMS delegation: authority over the key is delegated to the external account, which must also allow it via its own IAM policies. RESOURCE-KMS-ACCOUNT-DELEGATION high (external). Not public; not root-only. The silent-policy inversion does NOT fire (an account-delegation statement is present, albeit external).
